biography.value: A Forest Sovereign is not a creature a summoner commands. It is a being of significant age and power that has agreed, for reasons of its own, to be present. Ancient Authority can Charm an entire encounter's worth of enemies simultaneously. Sovereign's Gaze applies permanent Charm at Margin 3 with no save. Verdant Aura heals designated allies every round without requiring any action. The Forest Sovereign will follow precise instructions phrased as a proper exchange — something offered, something received, terms stated explicitly. It will then execute those terms with the thoroughness of something that has been keeping careful accounts since before most of the summoner's ancestors were born. A summoner who understands this and negotiates accordingly will find the Forest Sovereign the most capable Fae ally available. One who does not will find it technically cooperative in ways that somehow, over time, trend toward the Forest Sovereign's interests rather than their own.

system.sensesNotes: Darkvision 120 ft, Low-Light Vision, Perfect sight 120 ft, Tremorsense 1 mile (through roots and living plants)
system.attacksNotes:
Branch Slam [Combat]: Melee attack (Agil 8 + Melee Combat 7), Reach: 15 ft.

  • Margin 1:: 15 damage (9 + 6 Str) + 5 psychic damage (Ignore DR).
  • Margin 2: 15 damage, DR halved (round up) + 5 psychic damage; target Charmed for 1 hour treating the Forest Sovereign as a trusted authority; Will [Hard] save to resist; Charmed target will not attack the Forest Sovereign or its designated allies.
  • Margin 3: 15 damage, DR halved (round up) + 5 psychic damage + Charmed; no save; target also Restrained by animate roots for 1 minute as the Forest Sovereign's will reaches through the ground.

Sovereign's Gaze [Combat]: Ranged attack (Cha 8 + Persuasion 8), Range: 60 ft — this is a social/magical attack, not a physical one.

  • Margin 1:: Target Charmed for 1 minute; Will [Hard] save to resist.
  • Margin 2: Target Charmed for 1 hour; no save; target also cannot intentionally harm any creature the Forest Sovereign has designated as protected.
  • Margin 3: Target Charmed permanently until the Forest Sovereign chooses to release them or they receive Major Restoration; no save.
system.specialAbilitiesNotes: Forest Domain: In natural terrain, communicates with all plants and beasts within 1 mile. Animates roots and vines in a 40-foot diameter as a [Combat] action, area becomes Difficult Terrain and creatures within it make Reflex [Easy] saves each round or gain 1 Bleeding stack. Duration: 1 minute. Verdant Aura: Allies designated by the Forest Sovereign within 30 feet regain 6 HP at the start of their turns. This includes the summoner. Ancient Authority (1/encounter) [Combat]: As 2 [Combat] actions, addresses all creatures within 60 feet. Each creature that can hear it makes a Will [Hard] save. Failure: Charmed for 1 hour, treating the Forest Sovereign as a trusted sovereign whose reasonable instructions must be followed. 1 success: Charmed until end of their next turn only. Fae Compact: The Forest Sovereign is bound by Fae law to honor precise agreements, but the Forest Sovereign's definition of a fair exchange and the summoner's definition may differ significantly. The Forest Sovereign will not be cheated and remembers every interaction even across decades if necessary. Resilient Defense (3/day): When the Forest Sovereign fails a saving throw, it may choose to succeed instead. Action Points (3): Boss template. Spend at the end of any other creature's turn: Move (1, up to half speed), Attack (1, no Multiple Action Penalty), Detect (1), Special Ability (2). Regains all at the start of its own turn.
